business_summary: Shandong Sinocera Functional Material Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of ceramic materials and products in China and internationally. The company operates through six segments: Electronic Materials, Catalytic Materials, Biomedical Materials, New Energy Materials, Precision Ceramics, and Digital Printing and Other Materials. It offers ceramic powders and basic materials, including MLCC dielectric material, zirconia, alumina, boehmite, electronic paste, solar electronic paste, and filler for high-frequency copper-clad laminate; catalytic materials, such as honeycomb ceramic, zeolite, and cerium zirconium oxide mixture; and biomedical materials comprising zirconia ceramics for all-ceramic denture and preformed polymer-based crown and bridge. The company also provides ceramic ball, structure, and substrate; conventional, ultra-soft, and ultra-thin thermal gap fillers; and ceramic inks and pigments, as well as materials for HD display. In addition, it is involved in technology promotion and application services; wholesale of non-metallic minerals and products; business services; pharmaceutical manufacturing; computer, communication, and other electronic equipment manufacturing; property management; and real estate development and operation. The company's products are used in consumer electronics, vehicle, biomedical and catalytic materials, home decor, and ceramic structure applications. It exports its products. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Dongying, China.
